layout.name: unpartitioned
layout.description: One unpartitioned Iceberg table written with a single INSERT and default settings, as in ClickBench's presto-iceberg setup.

layout.name: sorted
layout.description: Rows sorted by ClickBench's primary key (CounterID, EventDate, UserID, EventTime, WatchID) when written, so min/max statistics let scans skip row groups for the many queries that filter on CounterID = 62 and an EventDate range. Trino sorts each written file; ranges can overlap between files.
layout.basis: The sort order is the primary key of ClickBench's reference ClickHouse table; applying it to an Iceberg table is a bencholap layout for pruning tests, not a published ClickBench setup.

layout.name: date-partitioned
layout.description: Identity partitioning by EventDate (one partition per day, 31 days in July 2013). Date-range queries (Q36-Q42) can skip whole partitions during planning.
layout.basis: bencholap layout for partition-pruning tests, not a published ClickBench setup.

layout.name: bloom-filters
layout.description: Unpartitioned and unsorted, with Parquet bloom filters on UserID, URLHash and RefererHash: the point lookups of Q19 (UserID = ...) and Q40/Q41 (RefererHash / URLHash = ...) can skip row groups whose min/max range contains the value but whose bloom filter does not.
layout.basis: bencholap layout for bloom-filter tests, not a published ClickBench setup.
